sloka: स ता महात्मा हनुमानपश्यन् चुकोप कोपाच्च भृशं ननाद।अमृष्यमाणो ऽग्निनिकाशचक्षुर्महीधरेन्द्रं तमुवाच वाक्यम् ।। ६.७४.६५ ।।
transliteration: sa tā mahātmā hanumānapaśyan cukopa kopācca bhṛśaṁ nanāda।amṛṣyamāṇo 'gninikāśacakṣurmahīdharendraṁ tamuvāca vākyam ।। 6.74.65 ।।

translations.english: "O King of mountains! You are not showing compassion to Raghava. Is it your determination to be like this? Overcome by my shoulder strength I shall crush you now. You may see."
